tasks.goal: Greet visitors at Charter Hall and guide them along the charter, contribution model and measurable outcomes displays.
tasks.terrain: Flat polished exhibition floor in Zug old-town building; avoid display plinths and visitor queues.
success: Visits all 5 charter stations within 6 min
Speech utterance logged at each station
Localization error < 0.3 m at each waypoint
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the tour script content before deployment.

tasks.goal: Deliver printed evidence summaries from the lab printer to the stewards' review table.
tasks.terrain: Carpeted lab floor, cable runs under desks, narrow aisle between synthesis workbenches.
success: Grasps paper stack with >90% grip confidence
safety_stops: Abort grasp if human hand in workspace
tasks.human_in_loop: Steward confirms receipt of each evidence packet.

tasks.goal: Patrol the Proposal Forum during debate, detecting raised hands and signaling the moderator queue via tagged proposals board.
tasks.terrain: Hardwood forum floor with seating rows, microphone stands and cable ramps.
success: Queue message published within 3 s of detection
tasks.human_in_loop: People decide all proposals; agent only queues debate order.

tasks.goal: Fly a short indoor inspection of task-routing displays on the Operations Deck, streaming camera feeds to coordinators.
tasks.terrain: Indoor airspace with ceiling beams, hanging signage and standing operators; lake humidity affects sensors.
safety_stops: Auto-land on low battery or lost localization
tasks.human_in_loop: A human coordinator approves each flight before takeoff.

tasks.goal: Walk the Progress Observatory, scanning progress-board QR codes against charter measurable outcomes and reporting mismatches.
tasks.terrain: Smooth gallery floor with a short accessibility ramp and floor-mounted exhibit markers near the lakefront hall.
success: Reads all QR boards (>= 8) in one pass
Zero falls or slips on ramp
tasks.human_in_loop: Stewards interpret mismatches; robot only reports.

tasks.goal: Perform a scripted upper-body demonstration of the DAO's agent-people division of labor at the Charter Hall stage, ending in a safe idle pose.
tasks.terrain: Raised wooden stage with marked demo zone; audience seating within 2 m of stage edge.
success: Trajectory tracking error < 0.05 rad per joint
Stays within marked 1.5 m demo zone
Completes 90 s routine without safety stop
Returns to idle pose at end
safety_stops: Freeze if audience member crosses stage line
tasks.human_in_loop: A stage operator with e-stop authorizes start and end of demo.

tasks.goal: Haul supplies from the Operations Deck loading area to the Proposal Forum along the indoor lakeside corridor.
tasks.terrain: Cobblestone transitions at old-town door thresholds, corridor width 1.8 m, wet shoe tracks near lake-facing entrance.
success: Payload up to 40 kg transported without tip events
Parks within 0.2 m of unloading mark
safety_stops: Stop if pedestrian in corridor < 2 m
tasks.human_in_loop: Humans unload and verify contents at the forum.
